adapter_review_findings: SoLEXS adapter accepts missing TIME and COUNTS TUNIT metadata and labels COUNTS as counts/s using a publicly discoverable manual; the local archives omit both column units. This project does not treat that repost as the registered product contract.
SoLEXS adapter converts TIME directly as Unix seconds and assigns 2-22 keV/one-second cadence without a registered matching product manual in the current evidence set.
SoLEXS adapter does not apply the matching GTI companions. HEL1OS adapter remains fail-closed.
No adapter change was made because the documentary basis needed to implement a valid conversion/GTI/quality policy is unavailable; the readiness gate remains blocked.
